observations: Industrial-style standing pedestal fan, black wire safety cage, four (visible three in some shots) wood-tone colored blades.
Gold/brass colored motor hub with a small circular logo badge, text too small/blurry to read in any photo.
Black round weighted cast base with handle-like spokes, black metal pole/stand.
All four photos are near-identical angles of the same fan head/base, taken in the same room with a visible carton box and fridge/appliance in background.
No photo shows the plug, power cord, rear motor housing, speed-control switch/dial, or the fan oscillating or spinning.
No photo of the claimed receipt or warranty card.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI BLESSING ODII' overlaid on all images.
Seller's new reply is text only, reasserting prior claims; no new photo or video was supplied.

claims.claim: Bought as brand new, working perfectly well
claims.evidence: No photo or clip shows the fan powered on, blades spinning, or oscillating.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year
claims.evidence: Age and usage history cannot be determined from static photos.

claims.claim: No fault at all, the motor was never opened
claims.evidence: Motor housing/rear is not shown in any photo; no tamper seal or screw condition visible.
Neither receipt nor warranty card appears in any of the 4 photos.

claims.claim: "I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true"
claims.evidence: Verbal reassurance only; no video or new photo provided to show the fan running.

risks.risk: Motor may not run or may run weakly/noisily
risks.proof: Short video of fan plugged in, running at low and high speed, blades spinning freely

risks.risk: Speed control switch or oscillation mechanism could be faulty
risks.proof: Clip showing switch being toggled through speeds and oscillation engaged

risks.risk: Cord/plug could be damaged, frayed, or non-standard (fire/safety risk)
risks.proof: Clear photo of full cord length and plug head
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / needing cord replacement

risks.risk: Blade balance/wobble causing vibration or noise
risks.proof: Video of fan running at top speed showing steady blade rotation

risks.risk: Receipt/warranty card could be absent or non-transferable
risks.proof: Photo of the actual receipt and warranty card with date and seller's name

risks.risk: Base or cage may have rust or cracks hidden by camera angle/shadow
risks.proof: Close-up photos of base underside and cage joints in bright light
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic condition unconfirmed, assume moderate wear

proof_requests: Video of the fan plugged in and running through all speed settings with oscillation
Clear photo of the plug and full power cord
Close-up photo of the motor hub badge/logo in focus to confirm brand
Photo of the actual receipt and warranty card
Photo of the rear motor housing and base underside
response.reason: The seller's text reassurance adds no visual proof, so all functional claims remain unverified; the fan is still priced at worst case as an unconfirmed-working unit pending a power-on video and close-ups.
